subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, We want to inform you that there was a delay in processing your recent order. Our team is working diligently to resolve this issue and ensure that your package is delivered to you as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your patience. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services.
